## What's new

- **A cleaner home screen widget.** The title, artist and controls are centred on one another, and the whole widget is centred, with no more rows stuck to the left.
- **Artwork is optional.** When you place the widget, choose whether it shows the artwork. When it does, the artwork sits to the left of the text and controls. Long-press the widget and choose reconfigure to change it later.
- **Resize it.** The artwork, text and buttons grow with the widget, from a single row up to a large tile, and the layout redraws as you resize.
- Previous and next are now chevrons, the buttons show a ripple and are easier to hit, and tapping anywhere else on the widget opens the player. On Android 12 and later the corners match your launcher's other widgets.

## Install

Download **Kultr-1.2.2.apk** below and open it on your phone. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your servers, library and downloads. Widgets already on your home screen switch to the new look and keep showing the artwork. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
